schema_shadowed_rules.justification: The standalone missing/empty-authorization predicate is structurally schema-shadowed: an admit requires the object and its six required members. Temporal ordering is attributed to expiry; this does not prove transaction, audience, scope or trust-policy validity.
The DCMP-2 response conditional structurally forbids authorization for every non-admit outcome, so this semantic violation cannot be schema-valid.
